updated_tables.name: personal_text_previews
updated_tables.owner_query: SELECT p.rowid AS rid,r.account_id,p.tenant_id FROM personal_text_previews p JOIN chat_runs r ON r.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND r.id=p.run_id
updated_tables.key_transition: Preserve per-run broker binding and receipt. Fence restored and unknown calls against the installation ledger before any new dispatch.
updated_tables.verification: Exact schema; row count; unique existing owner; declared FK integrity and cross-owner FK check
updated_tables.on_failure: Stop dry run; quarantine unresolved ownership, never infer owner from email or table name.

updated_tables.name: personal_task_history
updated_tables.owner_query: SELECT h.id AS rid,r.account_id,h.tenant_id FROM personal_task_history h JOIN personal_browser_jobs b ON b.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND b.run_id=h.run_id JOIN chat_runs r ON r.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND r.id=b.run_id AND r.thread_id=b.thread_id
updated_tables.key_transition: Retain recorded state changes with the owning browser job.
updated_tables.verification: Verify each event belongs to one retained browser job and original conversation.
updated_tables.on_failure: Stop extraction and quarantine unresolved task history.

updated_tables.name: member_google_thread_reads
updated_tables.owner_query: SELECT rowid AS rid,account_id,tenant_id FROM member_google_thread_reads
updated_tables.key_transition: Encrypted private mailbox observations are bound to owner, volume, generation, app, connection and epoch. Exclude from knowledge archives; do not reuse across an unverified restore.
updated_tables.verification: Exact schema, owner and thread FKs; source binding and ciphertext AAD; uncertain reads never redispatch.
updated_tables.on_failure: Quarantine affected observation; never infer authority from mailbox or reuse a request.
